subject: design/feature-draft-v1
statement: Readiness is one verdict computed in memory over the draft's compiled records together with the mainline's records, with no reverse check that every decision serves a requirement (`design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design#D-7`). It runs locally, as the draft pull request's required check, and at lock preparation, whose rebase makes it run against the mainline current at that moment (`prd:feature-draft/FR-24`, `UB-8`). A mainline that moves after preparation and before the merge is not refused yet: that case is §7 Q1.
